picks.why: colored bird’s-eye view of the bay with the walled town “Xixon” on the Cimadevilla headland between its two beaches; title cartouche and frame cut

picks.why: color general view of the old town from the beach: Revillagigedo palace tower, walls and the old church of San Pedro

notes: #1 is in Commons’ “Old maps of Gijón” but is a pictorial bird’s-eye landscape (mountains, town drawn as buildings), not a street plan; the town itself is small in the picture. #11 is only 1200 px wide. #9 (El Musel aerial, 1962) shows the outer port and hills rather than the town. #4 (market hall, 1884) and #5/#6 (royal bathing hut and coal arch, 1858) are single structures; #7 and #10 are maps; #15 (marina at sunset, 2018) is not better than the existing 2022 Cimadevilla view.
